queries: WITH s AS (SELECT brokrepstat, AVG(modelconf) AS a FROM compliancecase GROUP BY brokrepstat), b AS (SELECT AVG(a) AS base FROM s), q AS (SELECT s.brokrepstat, s.a FROM s CROSS JOIN b WHERE s.a > b.base), m AS (SELECT AVG(a) AS qm FROM q) SELECT q.brokrepstat, q.a AS avg_modelconf, q.a - b.base AS diff_from_baseline, q.a / m.qm AS ratio_to_qualifying_mean FROM q CROSS JOIN b CROSS JOIN m WHERE b.base IS NOT NULL AND m.qm IS NOT NULL AND m.qm <> 0 ORDER BY q.a DESC

WITH s AS (SELECT brokrepstat, AVG(modelconf) AS a FROM compliancecase GROUP BY brokrepstat), b AS (SELECT AVG(a) AS base FROM s), q AS (SELECT s.brokrepstat, s.a, b.base FROM s CROSS JOIN b WHERE s.a > b.base), m AS (SELECT AVG(a) AS qm FROM q) SELECT q.brokrepstat, q.a AS avg_modelconf, q.a - q.base AS diff_from_baseline, q.a / m.qm AS ratio_to_qualifying_mean FROM q CROSS JOIN m WHERE q.base IS NOT NULL AND m.qm IS NOT NULL

WITH per_status AS (SELECT brokrepstat, AVG(modelconf) AS avg_conf FROM compliancecase GROUP BY brokrepstat), baseline AS (SELECT AVG(avg_conf) AS base FROM per_status), qualifying AS (SELECT p.brokrepstat, p.avg_conf FROM per_status p, baseline b WHERE p.avg_conf > b.base), qmean AS (SELECT AVG(avg_conf) AS qm FROM qualifying) SELECT q.brokrepstat, q.avg_conf AS average_model_confidence, q.avg_conf - b.base AS diff_from_baseline, q.avg_conf / m.qm AS ratio_to_qualifying_mean FROM qualifying q CROSS JOIN baseline b CROSS JOIN qmean m WHERE b.base IS NOT NULL AND m.qm IS NOT NULL

assumptions.assumption: Cases with NULL brokrepstat form one group (GROUP BY keeps NULL as its own group) and count as one status in the baseline.
A status whose modelconf values are all NULL has a NULL average; it is excluded from the baseline mean and cannot qualify.
Returning nothing when a reference value is missing means: no rows if the baseline or the qualifying-statuses mean is NULL (or zero, which would make the ratio undefined).

assumptions.assumption: Cases with NULL brokrepstat form their own group, and that group counts once in the baseline mean of per-status averages and can qualify. A status whose modelconf values are all NULL has a NULL average, so it is skipped in the baseline and cannot qualify.
Ratio is a status's average divided by the mean of the qualifying statuses' averages. The result is empty when the baseline or that mean is NULL.

assumptions.assumption: Cases with NULL brokrepstat form one group (GROUP BY puts NULLs together), shown with a NULL status value.
A status whose cases all have NULL modelconf has a NULL average. It is left out of the baseline mean and cannot qualify.
The query returns no rows when the baseline is NULL or the mean of the qualifying averages is NULL or zero-rowed.
